principles: Primary user-facing command language is lattice; koala remains compatibility alias only.
State and signed authority identifiers stay stable unless a dedicated migration story owns the risk.
rollout_check is read-only and explanatory by default, never an apply/repair command.
External projects should receive actionable WARN/FAIL categories instead of opaque command failures.
drivers: Existing projects and historical story evidence depend on .koala paths and koala-review-* lane IDs.
Users need one command to understand rollout status across multiple real projects.
The CLI already exposes lattice as primary bin, but help/hints still leak koala wording.

options.name: docs-only rename
cons: Does not solve cross-project rollout friction

options.name: full identity rename
cons: High risk to .koala state, signed reviewer lanes, package identity, and historical evidence
Too broad for this rollout story

options.name: surface migration plus rollout_check
pros: Aligns user-visible command semantics with lattice
Adds a concrete cross-project rollout tool
cons: Some internal koala identifiers remain by design
Requires tests to distinguish user command wording from historical authority identifiers

rationale: Choose a user-facing surface migration plus read-only rollout_check because it solves the immediate product confusion without breaking historical Koala state or signed reviewer evidence.

preMortem.scenario: Help text migration accidentally rewrites reviewer lane or .koala authority terminology.
preMortem.trigger: A broad string replacement touches agent IDs or signed artifact semantics.
preMortem.consequence: Review/DONE gates or historical story evidence no longer line up with existing files.
preMortem.mitigation: Use targeted edits and tests; keep .koala, koala-review-* and @koala-agent/core unchanged in this story.

preMortem.scenario: rollout_check mutates real projects during patrol.
preMortem.trigger: Implementation calls check --apply or repair-style commands instead of read-only checks.
preMortem.consequence: A rollout scan changes managed assets unexpectedly across projects.
preMortem.mitigation: Use read-only subprocesses only; smoke test asserts no file changes in fixture projects.

preMortem.scenario: External projects produce noisy hard failures.
preMortem.trigger: A project lacks Koala/Lattice managed assets, node_modules, or local packages/main.
preMortem.consequence: Users cannot distinguish healthy warning from real blocker.
preMortem.mitigation: Normalize command exit codes into PASS/WARN/FAIL with nextAction and captured snippets.

preMortem.scenario: Docs say lattice but examples still show koala in key flows.
preMortem.trigger: README and help output are updated unevenly.
preMortem.consequence: User remains unsure whether to type lattice check or koala check.
preMortem.mitigation: Add smoke checks for README/help snippets and include TEST transcript from real projects.
